text:
Sofia K: quick sync — we need a concise set of guardrails for cross-tenant throttling + region fallback so PMs can commit to launch criteria by next quarter
Ethan L: agree. can we list what counts as a showstopper vs a mitigatable risk?
Maya P: showstoppers: unbounded tenant noise causing tail latency spikes, region split without fallback, no per-tenant quotas in control plane
Ravi S: mitigatable: cold-start variance, small perf regressions that we can offset with routing to reserved capacity
Sofia K: +1. proposal: three success metrics: 95th latency under Xms, no tenant > Y% of cluster QPS, automatic fallback to second-region with <1s extra p99 for 99.9% of requests
Ethan L: that second-region fallback SLA seems ambitious. can we make it conditional based on model size / dependency?
Maya P: yes — plan: policy tiers. Tier A (SLA customers) have cross-region warm-standby and synchronous failover. Tier B: async fallback with queue-based buffering. Tier C: best-effort fallback + clear doc warnings
Ravi S: for Tier A we need contracts: cold-warm keepalive, KV cache replication window, and per-tenant routing affinity hints. ops impact = provisioning + network egress costs
Sofia K: capturing dependencies: infra: route-service + policy-evaluator; runtime: cache-replication; billing: cross-region chargeback tagging; product: rollout gating criteria
Ethan L: can we show a sample policy grammar so eng & prod align? e.g.
```
policy:
  tenant_id: "T-123"
  tier: A
  region_preference: [us-west-2, eu-central-1]
  fallback: sync
  max_qps: 500
  eviction_policy: prefer-evict-nonhot
```
Maya P: looks good. add `max_burst` and `sla_contact` fields. also need an operators doc for manual override
Ravi S: ops note: we should expose a `force-fallback` flag in the console for live incidents (with audit log). also rate-limiter should support per-tenant token-bucket config
Sofia K: rollout plan sketch: 1) design + policy DSL (2 sprints), 2) infra prototype in staging (3 sprints), 3) small-customer pilot (4 weeks), 4) broad launch with opt-in + docs
Ethan L: blockers? I think model kv replication is the critical path — needs research spike on consistency window and perf impact
Maya P: I'll own spike. Ravi can you scope egress cost model for Tier A customers?
Ravi S: yes — will share numbers by EOD Wed.
Sofia K: ok can we list launch gating checklist before pilot: - policy DSL spec, - per-tenant quotas endpoints, - fallback wiring for one model family, - telemetry dashboards (latency + cross-region fail counts), - runbook + ops flag
Ethan L: added: automated test harness that injects tenant noise and validates guardrail thresholds
Maya P: i'll draft the policy DSL + runbook and post PR to the docs repo by Friday :wave:
Sofia K: sweet. tagging @deploy-bot to capture deploy window for the prototype
deploy-bot: scheduled staging cluster maintenance window: 2024-12-03 02:00-04:00 UTC — reply with CONFIRM to reserve
Sofia K: CONFIRM
Ethan L: thanks all — i'll update the roadmap ticket with these acceptance criteria and link back here
Maya P: thanks — will follow up with the DSL draft
Ravi S: sharing egress calc later this week.
Sofia K: end of thread — will sync again after Maya's draft and Ravi's numbers
